install_steps: curl -O -L https://github.com/grafana/loki/releases/latest/download/promtail-linux-amd64.zip && unzip -o promtail-linux-amd64.zip && chmod +x promtail-linux-amd64 && mkdir -p ~/.local/bin && mv promtail-linux-amd64 ~/.local/bin/promtail && rm promtail-linux-amd64.zip
note: Uses single-dash Go flags (-version, -config.file, -dry-run). For arm64 use promtail-linux-arm64.zip. Also available as a Docker image (grafana/promtail) and Debian/RPM packages. Requires a config file (-config.file) to run as an agent.
